summary.title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture

details: Understanding and generation in multimodal models are split across pretrained vision encoders vs. VAE/VQ latents, causing fragmented pipelines and a semantics-vs-pixel-fidelity trade-off imposed by intermediate representations.

SenseNova-U1: a native unified multimodal model (built on NEO-unify) that operates directly on raw pixels and words, with no pretrained vision encoder, no VAE, and no deep diffusion head — only two-layer conv patch encoding (32x32 patches) and an MLP pixel-prediction head.

Single Mixture-of-Transformers backbone: one sequence, shared self-attention (causal for text, bidirectional within image blocks, clean tokens masked from noise tokens), with fully decoupled per-stream parameters routed by token type; jointly trained with autoregressive cross-entropy for text and pixel-space flow matching for images.
Resolution-adaptive noise scale sigma_R = sigma_0*sqrt(N/N_0) plus explicit noise-scale conditioning, to keep per-token SNR constant across variable-resolution pixel-space flow matching.
SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT: dense, 42 layers, hidden 4096, shallow Pre-Buffer + Post-LLM, symmetric 8.2B understanding / 8.2B generation streams.
SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT: 48 layers, hidden 2048, no Pre-Buffer; stream-wise MoE with 128 understanding experts (30B) and 32 generation experts (8B), top-8 routing (~3B active).
Native RoPE reallocating pretrained LLM head dimensions across T/H/W axes (separate frequency bases; theta 5e6 temporal, 1e4 spatial), no extra parameters.

Stage 1 understanding warmup from pretrained NEO (attention fusion of QK projections then full-model continuation, 0.75T tokens); Stage 2 generation pretraining with frozen understanding branch in 3 phases (256^2->512^2, then up to 2048^2, then adding editing/reasoning/interleaved data); Stage 3 unified mid-training (84K steps, sampling ratio und:gen:edit:interleave = 0.33:0.37:0.24:0.06, loss weights CE:MSE = 0.1:1); Stage 4 unified SFT (9K steps).

Stage 5 RL post-training with Flow-GRPO using OCR IoU (PaddleOCR), VLM-judged style-following, and HPSv3 aesthetic rewards, interleaved reward groups, plus dynamic-resolution warmup; Stage 6 DMD2 distillation cutting NFE from 100 to 8.
Inference: unified CFG with separate text (gamma=4) and image-context (gamma_img=1) guidance, timestep shift 3.0, CFG renormalization; generate at 2K and downsample to 1K for evaluation.

Understanding: web text, image-text pairs, interleaved docs for pretraining; internal SenseNova V6.5 mid-training mix (General 39.2%, Agent/Spatial 22.3%, Knowledge Reasoning 19.3%, Text 19.2%) curated via CLIP-diversity sampling, prompt augmentation, multi-criteria model-based filtering; SFT organized by capability-atomic dimensions.

Generation: T2I corpus over Nature (~40.5%), People (~26.7%), Design (~20.7%) plus infographics and bilingual text rendering; editing corpus validated by decomposing instructions into change/preserve objectives; compact interleaved corpus (Lifestyle ~44%, Infographics ~29%, Video ~19%, Reasoning ~8% with CoT traces).

Understanding: MMMU/MMMU-Pro, MathVista/MathVision, MMBench-EN, MMStar, InfoVQA, OCRBench v1/v2, AI2D, HallusionBench, BabyVision, TiR; spatial via EASI on VSI-Bench, ViewSpatial, MindCube-Tiny, 3DSR-Bench; text via MMLU-Pro/Redux, C-Eval, SuperGPQA, IFEval, IFBench; agentic via tau^2-Bench and Claw-Eval. Evaluated with EvalScope, LLM-as-judge (gpt-4o-mini).

Generation/editing: GenEval, DPG-Bench, OneIG-Bench (EN/ZH), TIIF-Bench, CVTG-2K, LongText-Bench, IGenBench, BizGenEval, WISE, ImgEdit, GEdit-Bench, RISEBench; interleaved/unified reasoning: OpenING, VBVR-Image (preview), Uni-MMMU GaU, RealUnify.
Baselines include Qwen3-VL-8B, Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, LongCat, Qwen-Image(-Edit), BAGEL, OneCAT, Mogao, Lumina-DiMOO, Z-Image, Emu-3.5, Seedream 4.5, Nano Banana, GPT-4o+DALL-E3.

Disaggregated inference: LightLLM for understanding/text streaming, LightX2V for generation, exchanging state via pinned shared memory; hybrid attention kernel with b_image_token_end (Triton and FlashAttention3) preserving causal fast path for text-only blocks; TP2+CFG2 for 2048x2048 gives 0.415s/0.443s per step on 5090/L40S.
Ablations use a 2B NEO-unify (reconstruction, frozen-understanding editing) and the 8B-MoT backbone (co-training conflict, data-scaling curves on DPG-Bench, WISE, GEdit-Bench, RISEBench).

key_findings.finding: A fully encoder-free, VAE-free architecture with 32x compression can simultaneously match strong understanding-only VLMs and top image generators.
key_findings.evidence: Both variants reach 0.91 overall on GenEval (vs. Qwen-Image 0.87, Lumina-DiMOO 0.88, BAGEL 0.82), top-tier DPG-Bench scores (A3B best Global), and the paper reports consistently outperforming Qwen3-VL-8B (same LLM base) on multimodal reasoning and text-rich understanding without understanding-specific RL.

key_findings.finding: Native pixel-space modeling yields state-of-the-art text rendering and text-rich/infographic generation.
key_findings.evidence: 8B-MoT attains 0.979 LongText-Bench-EN and 0.962 ZH (A3B: 0.950/0.955), best average word accuracy 0.940 on CVTG-2K across 2-5 text regions, best Text score on both OneIG-EN and OneIG-ZH, best overall on TIIF-Bench, and strongest open-source results on IGenBench and BizGenEval hard split.

key_findings.finding: The unified framework produces genuine bidirectional synergy between understanding and generation, amplified by chain-of-thought.
key_findings.evidence: 8B-MoT-SFT achieves 35.0 GaU average on Uni-MMMU (above BAGEL, OmniGen2, Ovis-U1) and best overall 52.4 on RealUnify (55.7 UEG / 47.5 GEU); on RISEBench CoT lifts A3B from 25.3 to 30.0 (Logical 7.1 -> 20.0) and 8B from 23.9 to 26.9; OpenING best overall 9.16 with CoT, above Nano Banana and GPT-4o+DALL-E3.

key_findings.finding: The Mot design keeps understanding and generation nearly conflict-free while scaling efficiently with data.
key_findings.evidence: With low understanding data ratio and CE:MSE weight of 0.1:1 during joint mid-training, understanding stays stable while generation converges rapidly (Figure on GEdit-Bench normalized scores); data-scaling curves on DPG-Bench, WISE, GEdit-Bench and RISEBench improve steadily, with mid-training nearly converged by 40K steps on <80M samples.

key_findings.finding: The near-lossless visual interface retains pixel fidelity comparable to a latent VAE and supports editing even with a frozen understanding branch.
key_findings.evidence: 2B NEO-unify reaches 31.56 PSNR / 0.85 SSIM on MS-COCO 2017 after only 90K pretraining steps versus FLUX.1-dev VAE at 31.56 PSNR / 0.93 SSIM, and scores 3.32 on ImgEdit after 60K mixed-training steps using only public T2I and editing data with the understanding branch frozen.
